properties.title: Special Marine Warning issued August 10 at 7:16AM EDT until August 10 at 8:15AM EDT by NWS Cleveland OH
properties.description:
For the following areas...
Nearshore waters from Reno Beach OH to the Islands OH...
Open waters from Reno Beach OH to The Islands OH...

At 716 AM EDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 11 nm northwest of Put-In-Bay to 17 nm southeast of
North Cape, moving east at 45 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

Locations impacted include...
Put-In-Bay and Kelleys Island.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Frequent lightning is occurring with these storms. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.
properties.area: Reno Beach to The Islands OH; Reno Beach to The Islands OH beyond 5NM off shoreline to US-Canadian border

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued August 10 at 7:06AM EDT by NWS Northern Indiana
properties.description:
At 706 AM EDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 8
miles north of Van Buren, or 10 miles south of Huntington, moving
east at 50 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and nickel size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Huntington, Bluffton, Decatur, Berne, Ossian, Geneva, Markle, Van
Buren, Monroe, Warren, Lancaster, Preble, Nottingham, Zanesville,
Uniondale, Poneto, Vera Cruz, Mcnatts, Yoder, and Wellsburg.

This includes Interstate 69 in Indiana between mile markers 268 and
295.
properties.instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.
properties.area: Allen; Huntington; Wells; Adams; Grant; Jay

properties.title: Special Weather Statement issued August 10 at 7:00AM EDT by NWS Cleveland OH
properties.description:
At 659 AM EDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms along
a line extending from 8 miles east of Oregon to Woodville to 6 miles
north of Fostoria. Movement was east at 50 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Fremont, Port Clinton, Put-In-Bay, Bellevue, Clyde, Oak Harbor,
Gibsonburg, Genoa, Woodville, Elmore, Green Springs, Ballville,
Catawba Island, Marblehead, Bettsville, Risingsun, Lindsey, Rocky
Ridge, Clay Center, and Helena.
properties.instruction:
If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with these storms and may lead
to localized flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded
roadways.

Frequent cloud to ground lightning is occurring with these storms.
Lightning can strike 10 miles away from a thunderstorm. Seek a safe
shelter inside a building or vehicle.

properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued August 10 at 4:56AM CDT until August 10 at 11:00AM CDT by NWS Kansas City/Pleasant Hill MO
properties.description:
FFWEAX

The National Weather Service in Pleasant Hill has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Southern Johnson County in east central Kansas...

* Until 1100 AM CDT Monday.

* At 456 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1.5 and 2 inches of rain
have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1 to 2 inches in 1 hour.
Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1.5 inches are possible in
the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Overland Park, Olathe, Leawood, Gardner, Spring Hill, Clare,
Stanley and Stilwell.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued August 10 at 2:48AM CDT until August 10 at 10:00AM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northeastern Livingston County in central Illinois...
North Central Ford County in east central Illinois...
Iroquois County in east central Illinois...
Southeastern Grundy County in northeastern Illinois...
Southwestern Kankakee County in northeastern Illinois...
Benton County in northwestern Indiana...
Southwestern Newton County in northwestern Indiana...

* WHEN...Until 1000 AM CDT /1100 AM EDT/ Tonight.

* IMPACTS...Creeks and streams may rise out of their banks. Roads and
streets may be flooded. Slow moving or standing water may continue.
High water may recede slowly from flooded areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 248 AM CDT /348 AM EDT/, Doppler radar and automated rain
gauges indicated heavy rainfall moving out of the area, but some
streams will continue to rise due to earlier heavy rainfall.
Standing water may also be slow to recede in some areas. Up to 3
inches of rain occurred in northeastern Livingston County.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Streator, Watseka, Dwight, Fowler, Gilman, Kentland, Herscher,
Clifton, Milford, Otterbein, Onarga, Oxford, Sheldon, Odell,
South Streator, Boswell, Ashkum, Cullom, Martinton and Earl Park.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
A Flood Advisory means minor flooding along waterways and other poor
drainage areas is imminent or may already be occurring. Persons in
the advisory area should use caution and avoid flood waters.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.
properties.area: Ford, IL; Grundy, IL; Iroquois, IL; Kankakee, IL; Livingston, IL; Benton, IN; Newton, IN

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued August 10 at 3:31AM EDT until August 10 at 9:30AM EDT by NWS Grand Rapids MI
properties.description:

* WHERE...Portions of south central and southwest Michigan,

and Ionia. In southwest Michigan, Barry.

* WHEN...Until 930 AM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
